name: omlx
title: oMLX
description: Use locally running oMLX models as AI providers in Raycast

tools.name: list-models
tools.title: List Models
tools.description: List oMLX models with their load status, size, type, and capabilities. Optionally filter to only loaded or only available models.

tools.name: load-model
tools.title: Load Model
tools.description: Load an oMLX model into memory so it can serve requests. Use list-models first to find the model ID.

tools.name: eject-model
tools.title: Eject Model
tools.description: Eject an oMLX model from memory. Use list-models first to find loaded model IDs.

tools.name: pin-model
tools.title: Pin or Unpin Model
tools.description: Pin a model to keep it in memory (prevents automatic eviction), or unpin it.

tools.name: get-server-status
tools.title: Get Server Status
tools.description: Check if the oMLX server is running and get stats: version, uptime, loaded models, speed, memory usage, cache efficiency.

tools.name: get-model-stats
tools.title: Get Model Stats
tools.description: Get historical usage stats for a specific model from past requests: average speed (tok/s), total tokens served, cache hit rate. This is not a benchmark — it reflects real usage, not a controlled test. Use list-models first to find model IDs.

tools.name: search-models
tools.title: Search Models
tools.description: Search for models on HuggingFace. Returns model name, size, parameters, and download count. Results are MLX-compatible models only.

tools.name: download-model
tools.title: Download Model
tools.description: Download a model from HuggingFace. Use search-models first to find the repo ID.

tools.name: get-download-progress
tools.title: Get Download Progress
tools.description: Check the progress of active and recent model downloads.

tools.name: cancel-download
tools.title: Cancel Download
tools.description: Cancel an active model download. Use get-download-progress first to find the task ID.

tools.name: get-recommended-models
tools.title: Get Recommended Models
tools.description: Get trending and popular MLX models from HuggingFace.

tools.name: reload-models
tools.title: Reload Models
tools.description: Rescan the model directory to discover newly added or removed models.

tools.name: start-server
tools.title: Start Server
tools.description: Start the oMLX server if it is not already running.

tools.name: stop-server
tools.title: Stop Server
tools.description: Stop the oMLX server. All loaded models will be unloaded.

tools.name: restart-server
tools.title: Restart Server
tools.description: Restart the oMLX server. Active requests will be interrupted.

tools.name: check-updates
tools.title: Check for Updates
tools.description: Check if a new version of oMLX is available.

commands.name: manage-models
commands.title: Manage Models
commands.description: View, load, eject, pin, and delete oMLX models

commands.name: server-status
commands.title: Serving Stats
commands.description: View oMLX serving stats, speed, cache efficiency, and active models

commands.name: start-stop
commands.title: Start/Stop Server
commands.description: Start, stop, or restart the oMLX server

commands.name: download-model
commands.title: Download Model
commands.description: Search and download models from HuggingFace

commands.name: manage-downloads
commands.title: Manage Downloads
commands.description: View download progress, cancel, retry, or remove downloads

commands.name: check-updates
commands.title: Check for Updates
commands.description: Check if a new version of oMLX is available

commands.name: open-dashboard
commands.title: Open Web Dashboard
commands.description: Open the oMLX web dashboard in your browser
